# KM Color Options & Records (SBU: KM Kitbuyer)

> **System Context**: In E-DSR Consumables (`e-dsr-cons`), when the **SBU / Segment** is selected as `KM Kitbuyer` (Category ID `342`), the system activates the Consumables product and pricing module. Under this module, **Product Type** offers `KM Color` (Category ID `393`), `KM Mono` (Category ID `395`), and `RISO` (Category ID `396`).

## 📁 Generated Files
- [km_color_catalog.csv](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/e-dsr-cons/km_color_catalog.csv): Complete catalog of **857** items (55 Machine Models, Consumables, and Item Codes).
- [km_color_kitbuyer_encoded.csv](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/e-dsr-cons/km_color_kitbuyer_encoded.csv): All **316** historical encoded transaction line items recorded under `KM Kitbuyer` for `KM Color`.
